questions.stem: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework focuses on running and monitoring systems and continually improving processes and procedures?

options.rationale: Operational excellence covers running and monitoring systems and improving processes over time.
Reliability is about a workload performing its function correctly and recovering from failure.
Performance efficiency is about using resources efficiently as demand changes.
Sustainability is about reducing environmental impact.

questions.explanation: The six pillars are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization and sustainability. Operations and continuous improvement belong to operational excellence.

questions.stem: Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on a workload performing its intended function correctly and consistently, and recovering quickly from failure?

options.rationale: Operational excellence is about running and improving operations.
Reliability is about the ability of a workload to perform its intended function and recover from failures.
Security is about protecting data, systems and assets.
Cost optimization is about avoiding unnecessary cost.

questions.explanation: Reliability includes distributed system design, recovery planning and adapting to changing requirements.

questions.stem: Which Well-Architected pillar covers protecting data, systems and assets, including identity management and traceability?

options.rationale: Reliability is about recovering from failure, not protecting assets.
Operational excellence is about running and improving systems.
The security pillar covers confidentiality and integrity of data, managing user permissions, and detecting security events.
Performance efficiency is about using resources efficiently.

questions.explanation: The security pillar focuses on protecting information and systems, including identity, detection and data protection.

questions.stem: Selecting the right resource types and sizes and keeping them efficient as demand changes and technologies evolve is the focus of which pillar?

options.rationale: Cost optimization focuses on avoiding unnecessary costs.
Performance efficiency is about using computing resources efficiently to meet requirements as demand changes.
Sustainability is about minimizing environmental impact.
Operational excellence is about running and monitoring systems and improving operations.

questions.explanation: The clue is choosing resource types and sizes to meet demand, which is performance efficiency. Cost optimization looks at the same choices with the goal of lower spending.

questions.stem: Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on avoiding unnecessary costs and delivering business value at the lowest price point?

options.rationale: Cost optimization is about running systems to deliver business value at the lowest price point.
Performance efficiency is about efficient use of resources, not primarily cost.
Operational excellence is about operations and improvement.
Sustainability is about environmental impact.

questions.explanation: Cost optimization covers understanding spending, selecting the right pricing models and scaling to meet needs without overspending.

questions.stem: Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on minimizing the environmental impact of running cloud workloads?

options.rationale: Cost optimization is about spending, although it often aligns with sustainability.
Sustainability focuses on reducing energy consumption and increasing efficiency across a workload.
Performance efficiency is about meeting performance needs efficiently.
Operational excellence is about running and improving operations.

questions.explanation: The clue is environmental impact, which is the sustainability pillar's focus. Cost optimization often reduces waste too, but its goal is spending rather than energy and resource use.

questions.stem: A team automates its deployments and releases changes in small batches that are easy to roll back. Which Well-Architected pillar does this practice support?

options.rationale: Security covers protecting data, systems and assets, for example through identity and encryption.
Sustainability covers reducing the environmental impact of workloads.
Operational excellence covers how a team runs and changes its workloads, including safe automation and small, reversible changes.
Performance efficiency covers choosing and using resources efficiently to meet demand.

questions.explanation: The clue is how the team releases changes: automated, small, reversible changes are an operational excellence practice. Performance efficiency is about how well resources meet demand, not how changes are released.

questions.stem: A workload monitors its servers and automatically replaces any server that fails, without anyone stepping in. Which Well-Architected pillar does this design support?

options.rationale: Security covers protecting data, systems and assets.
Performance efficiency covers using resources efficiently as demand changes.
Reliability covers a workload performing its function correctly and recovering from failure, including automatic recovery.
Cost optimization covers avoiding unnecessary spending.

questions.explanation: The clue is recovering from failure automatically, which is the focus of reliability. Performance efficiency is about meeting demand efficiently, not about surviving failures.

questions.stem: How many pillars does the AWS Well-Architected Framework have?

options.rationale: Operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization and sustainability.
Four leaves out two of the pillars.
Five leaves out one of the pillars.
There are six pillars, not seven.

questions.explanation: The six pillars are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization and sustainability.

questions.stem: Which TWO practices belong to the security pillar of the Well-Architected Framework? (Choose TWO.)

options.text: Spreading a workload across several smaller resources
options.rationale: This limits the impact of a single failure, which is a reliability practice.

options.text: Granting each user the least privilege needed
options.rationale: Least privilege is part of the security pillar's strong identity foundation.

options.text: Testing different instance types to compare performance
options.rationale: Comparing resource types to meet performance needs is a performance efficiency practice.

options.text: Encrypting data at rest and in transit
options.rationale: Protecting data in transit and at rest, for example with encryption, is a security practice.

options.text: Stopping development servers outside working hours
options.rationale: Paying for resources while they are needed is a cost optimization practice.

questions.explanation: Least privilege and encryption protect data and systems, which is the security pillar's focus. The other practices improve resilience, speed or cost, so they belong to reliability, performance efficiency and cost optimization.

questions.stem: A team tests several instance types and a serverless option to see which gives its application the fastest response times. Which Well-Architected pillar does this practice support?

options.rationale: Cost optimization focuses on spending; the goal here is speed, not price.
Performance efficiency covers selecting the resources that best meet performance needs, including experimenting with different types.
Reliability covers performing correctly and recovering from failure.
Operational excellence covers running and improving operations.

questions.explanation: The clue is fastest response times: comparing resource types to meet performance needs is performance efficiency. Cost optimization would compare the same options on price instead.

questions.stem: A company stops its development and test servers at night and on weekends so that it pays for them only while they are in use. Which Well-Architected pillar does this practice support?

options.rationale: Performance efficiency covers meeting demand efficiently, not lowering the bill.
Reliability covers performing correctly and recovering from failure.
Operational excellence covers running and improving operations.
Cost optimization includes a consumption model: paying for resources while you need them and stopping them when you do not.

questions.explanation: The clue is paying for servers while they are used, which is the consumption model of cost optimization. Performance efficiency is about how well resources meet demand, not how much they cost.

questions.stem: A company combines several lightly used servers onto fewer, busier ones. Its stated goal is to cut the energy its workloads consume. Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on this goal?

options.rationale: Consolidation also saves money, but cost optimization focuses on spending, not energy use.
Sustainability covers reducing energy and resource use, for example by running fewer resources at higher utilization.
Reliability covers performing correctly and recovering from failure.
Security covers protecting data, systems and assets.

questions.explanation: The clue is the goal of using less energy, which is sustainability. Cost optimization often benefits from the same change, but its focus is spending.

questions.stem: What does the AWS Well-Architected Tool help a company do?

options.text: Run automated checks on an account and suggest cost and security fixes
options.rationale: That describes AWS Trusted Advisor, which checks account resources against best practices automatically.

options.text: Review workloads against the framework's pillars and track improvements
options.rationale: The Well-Architected Tool runs structured workload reviews against AWS best practices and records milestones and improvement plans.

options.text: Record configuration changes to resources and evaluate them against rules
options.rationale: That describes AWS Config.

options.text: Download AWS compliance reports and agreements on demand
options.rationale: That describes AWS Artifact.

questions.explanation: The tool is a structured review of a workload's design against the framework, with improvements you track over time. Trusted Advisor, the nearest neighbor, runs automated checks on account resources instead of a design review.

questions.stem: A company replaces one large server with several smaller servers so that the failure of one server has less impact on the application. Which Well-Architected pillar does this design support?

options.rationale: Reliability includes scaling horizontally so that a single failure does not take down the workload.
Performance efficiency covers meeting demand efficiently; the goal here is limiting the impact of failure.
Cost optimization covers avoiding unnecessary spending.
Security covers protecting data, systems and assets.

questions.explanation: The clue is reducing the impact of a failure, which is reliability. Performance efficiency also involves choosing resources, but its goal is meeting demand efficiently.

questions.stem: Which TWO are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose TWO.)

options.rationale: Cost optimization is one of the six pillars.
Business continuity is a goal the reliability pillar supports, not a pillar itself.
Sustainability is one of the six pillars.
High availability is a property the reliability pillar helps achieve, not a pillar.
Scalability is a property workloads aim for, not a pillar.

questions.explanation: The pillars are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization and sustainability.
